standings.fields: W, L, WIN%, home/road splits, conference and division records.

team_trad.fields: GP, MIN, PTS (points per game), +/-, per-team shooting splits.

team_opp.fields: Opponent PTS per game (points allowed), opponent shooting splits.

team_adv.fields: OffRtg, DefRtg, NetRtg, PACE, PIE - all per-100-possession.

schedule.fields: Game IDs, ET tip times, arenas, national broadcast, Emirates NBA Cup group.

games.fields: Official final scores, one page per date; the day-strip calendar gives the per-date game count used for the completeness check.

injury_pdf.fields: Per-player status (Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Probable/Available) with the stated reason.

injury_policy.fields: Filing deadlines: 5 p.m. local the day before; game day 11 a.m.-1 p.m.; 1 p.m. local for the second of a back-to-back.

player_trad.fields: Per-player GP, MIN, PTS, REB, AST for the rows used on this site.

players.fields: Per-player GP, MIN, PTS, REB, AST for the rows used on this site.

odds.what: Market prices (spread, total, moneyline, prop lines)
odds.why: No licensed odds feed is connected and NBA.com renders odds client-side only. Required for: any value/edge claim, stake sizing, ROI, leaderboard scoring.

live_ingest.what: An automated feed that keeps the results history current without a human capture
live_ingest.why: The 183 official finals from 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-13 ARE committed under data/raw/history/, and they rebuild every one of the 30 standings records exactly. Backtests, out-of-sample splits and settlement therefore run today. What is missing is a scheduled job that appends each night's results, so the history freezes between manual captures and the window ages.

player_box.why: nba.com/stats player pages render season aggregates only for this client. Required for: minutes distributions, prop bet probabilities, injury replacement modelling.

future_injuries.what: Injury designations for game days beyond the next filing deadline
future_injuries.why: The NBA publishes a report only once a team has filed. For a game on day +2 or +3 the filing deadline has not yet passed, so no official row exists to read.
